en: Vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge in the foreground and a church tower with an onion dome on the right. A hill with fortifications rises behind the town. Pedestrians walk along the embankment, and the river runs through the scene. On the bottom left is printed the caption "GRAZ von der Albrechtsbrücke." There is vertical publisher text on the left margin and handwritten cursive text on the right side, plus a circular postal cancellation mark overlapping the image.
